in_arabic.name: Dahiah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Dahiah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'd-h-h', meaning 'to be gentle' or 'to be tender'. This name is a reminder of the gentle and tender nature of Allah (swt) towards His creation.
